_metadata.source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56 (Crop Evapotranspiration - Guidelines for computing crop water requirements)
_metadata.authors: Richard G. Allen, Luis S. Pereira, Dirk Raes, Martin Smith (FAO, Rome, 1998)
_metadata.tables_referenced: Table 11 (Length of crop development stages) & Table 12 (Single crop coefficients Kc)
_metadata.note: Values verified against FAO-56 tables. For regional Indian pulses and groundnut cultivars, stage durations are verified against ICAR / TNAU package of practices. Specific Indian sub-variety variations are marked 'verified: false' for honesty.

rice.name: Rice (Paddy)
rice.notes: Paddy with standing water layer; high initial Kc due to open surface evaporation.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.notes: Rabi season cereal crop; sharp drop in late stage Kc as crop senesces.

maize.name: Maize (Corn)
maize.notes: Grain and silage corn; sensitive to water deficit during silking and tasseling.

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.notes: Deep-rooted Kharif fibre crop; high drought tolerance but peak water demand at boll formation.

groundnut.name: Groundnut (Peanut)
groundnut.notes: Legume oilseed; pegging and pod development stages are critical for moisture.

chilli.name: Chilli (Hot Pepper)
chilli.notes: Solanaceous spice crop; sensitive to moisture fluctuations causing blossom and flower drop.

tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.notes: High water demand at flowering and fruit enlargement; avoid excess watering near maturity.

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane
sugarcane.notes: Annual/perennial long-duration crop with heavy cumulative irrigation requirements.

soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.notes: Short duration Kharif legume; sensitive to waterlogging and drought at pod-fill.

pulses.name: Pulses (Pigeon Pea / Chickpea)
pulses.notes: Grain legumes; low water requirement; excess moisture promotes vegetative overgrowth.

Sandy.description: Coarse texture, rapid infiltration, low water retention.

Sandy Loam.description: Moderately coarse texture, good drainage, moderate water holding capacity.

Loam.description: Medium texture, balanced water retention and aeration.

Alluvial.description: Fertile riverine deposit, medium texture with good moisture retention.

Red Loam.description: Ferruginous loam, moderate to high water holding capacity.

Clay Loam.description: Fine texture, high moisture retention, slower drainage.

Black Cotton.description: Vertisol heavy montmorillonitic clay; deep swelling, very high water retention.

Clay.description: Heavy clay, very high water capacity, prone to surface waterlogging.

drip.name: Drip Irrigation
drip.notes: Direct root zone application; minimal evaporation and runoff.

sprinkler.name: Sprinkler Irrigation
sprinkler.notes: Overhead droplet distribution; moderate wind drift and foliar evaporation.

furrow.name: Furrow Irrigation
furrow.notes: Channel infiltration between raised beds; moderate deep percolation.

flood.name: Flood / Basin Irrigation
flood.notes: Whole field inundation; high conveyance loss and deep percolation.
